messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "if you break a scored tablet and take only half, take the other half at your next dose"
set: ["if you break a scored tablet and take only half, take the other half at your next dose", "take your next dose at the regular time", "take next dose at usual time", "skip the missed dose and take next dose at regular time", "if you miss your bedtime dose, take your next dose at the regular time the following evening", "take next dose at normal scheduled time", "take only if doctor tells you to", "if you take Horizant, skip the missed dose", "take next dose at regular time and stay on twice-daily schedule", "take only the amount prescribed by your doctor", "take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to", "do not take the missed dose if you miss a dose of the tablets", "only take potassium-rich foods if doctor tells you to", "especially if you take other drugs as well", "extended-release tablets are scored and can be split in half if your prescriber tells you to", "take dose in the morning"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
